lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.subtitle: City services brought into one app
lifecycle.desc: Lifecycle is a system for managing and tracking activity across a city, while giving residents a range of everyday services in one place.
lifecycle.problem: Bring a city's services and information together in a single app so residents can reach what they need far more easily.
lifecycle.result: The system is in operation across several cities in Japan, and DVL Tech continues to support, maintain and improve it as needs evolve.

foodWaste.title: Food waste reduction app
foodWaste.desc: An app connecting food suppliers with users, helping put products that would otherwise go to waste to good use.
foodWaste.problem: Cut the volume of food thrown away and create a more convenient way to distribute food products that still have value.
foodWaste.result: The app was built to address a real social problem, pairing technology with the goal of reducing food waste.

businessChat.title: Business Chat & Call Application
businessChat.desc: An application supporting business-to-business communication through messaging and calling. It lets users exchange information quickly and conveniently as they work.
businessChat.problem: Create one central communication channel for businesses, making information exchange easier and reducing reliance on many separate tools.
businessChat.result: The system provides direct communication between businesses, serving the need to exchange information in a working environment.

toyLabel.title: Toy Label Management System
toyLabel.desc: A system for managing the information and processes around labelling for toy products.
toyLabel.problem: Centralise label information, reduce manual handling, and make it easy to track and update product details.
toyLabel.result: The system digitised and centralised label information management, helping the business handle its data far more efficiently.

accessibilitySupport.title: Accessibility support application
accessibilitySupport.subtitle: Assistive technology for people who need support
accessibilitySupport.desc: An application built to help vulnerable people reach the information, services and support that fit their needs.
accessibilitySupport.problem: Create a technology tool that makes support information and services genuinely easy to reach in everyday life.
accessibilitySupport.result: The application makes information and support services far easier to reach for vulnerable users, lowering the barrier to using technology in everyday life.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At {company}, we respect and are committed to protecting the privacy of users, clients and partners who visit our website.

collect.heading: 1. Information we collect
collect.intro: We may collect the following information when you use the website:
items: Full name
Email
Phone number
Company name
Enquiry or consultation request content
Technical information: IP address, browser, device, browsing behaviour

purpose.heading: 2. How we use the information
items: Respond to enquiries and advise on services
Get in touch about projects and partnerships
Improve the user experience on the website
Analyse data to improve our products and marketing
Send service information (if you consent)

sharing.heading: 3. Sharing information
sharing.noSellStrong: does not sell, trade or rent
sharing.casesIntro: We only share information in the following cases:
items: With partners that help us operate the system (hosting, email, analytics, etc.)
When required by law enforcement authorities
When necessary to protect the legitimate interests of the company

security.heading: 4. Data security
items: HTTPS/SSL encryption for data in transit
Restricted internal access
Data stored on secured systems
security.caveat: That said, no method of transmission or storage can be guaranteed absolutely secure.

cookies.heading: 5. Cookies and browsing data
cookies.intro: The website uses an analytics system we run ourselves. We do not share the data with third parties and do not use it for advertising. The system sets two technical cookies:
cookies.visitorCookie: a random identifier for your browser, stored for up to 400 days, used to distinguish new visitors from returning ones
cookies.sessionCookie: a random identifier for a single visit, expiring after 30 minutes of inactivity
cookies.tracked: Alongside these, each visit records: IP address, browser and operating system information (User-Agent), the page paths viewed, the time and duration of each view, the referring page and campaign parameters (UTM) where present. IP addresses are stored in their original form for statistics and to detect unusual access; we do not use any third-party geolocation lookup service.
cookies.retention: Browsing data is retained for a maximum of 18 months. You can disable cookies in your browser, though some features may be affected.

thirdParty.heading: 6. Third-party links
thirdParty.body: The website may contain links to other websites. {company} is not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those third parties.

rights.heading: 7. Your rights
items: Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information
Request deletion of browsing data tied to your device, including stored IP addresses
Opt out of marketing communications
Request that we stop processing your data

contactSection.heading: 8. Contact
contactSection.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please get in touch:

privacy.updates: {company} may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on the website.
